> أكاديمية P2S (P2S Academy) — تأهيل طلاب الدبلومات التجارية لمعادلة كلية التجارة.
> P2S Academy prepares Egyptian commercial-diploma students for the Faculty of
> Commerce equivalency exam (معادلة كلية التجارة), organized by the Supreme
> Council of Universities. One exam, four subjects, one attempt.

## About

- Location: كفر الزيات، الغربية، مصر (Kafr El-Zayyat, Gharbia, Egypt).
- Founder: مستر أحمد علي (Mr. Ahmed Ali).
- Track record: ٢٨ نموذج نجاح (28 past success models).
- Service area: Egypt.
- Language: Arabic (ar-EG).
- Website: https://p2s-academy.com/

## Site structure

Single-page application with three hash-routed screens:

- [الأكاديمية](https://p2s-academy.com/#academy) — the academy, teacher,
  services, booking.
- [المعادلة](https://p2s-academy.com/#muadala) — the equivalency exam: 3-year
  vs 5-year diploma, eligibility, subjects, documents, FAQs.
- [الصور](https://p2s-academy.com/#gallery) — real photos from the 2026 ceremony
  and the honor roll.
- [احجز مكانك](https://p2s-academy.com/#book) — free eligibility-check booking
  form.

## Key facts

- Exam: معادلة كلية التجارة (Faculty of Commerce equivalency).
- Organizer: المجلس الأعلى للجامعات (Supreme Council of Universities).
- Format: 4 subjects, one hour each, multiple choice (MCQ), 50% pass mark per
  subject — not an average.
- Cycle: 2026/2027. One attempt.

### 3-year commercial diploma

- Eligibility: 3-year commercial technical diploma, 2026/2027 cohorts,
  overall grade ≥ 70%.
- Subjects: الرياضيات، اللغة الإنجليزية، السلوك التنظيمي، تكنولوجيا المعلومات.
- After passing: first year (الفرقة الأولى) of the Faculty of Commerce in public
  universities, subject to admission rules.
- Start: immediately after diploma exams, before results; attendance is free
  before results are announced.
- Documents: diploma certificate, certified transcript, national ID copy, two
  recent personal photos, application form, fee receipt. The list changes yearly.

### 5-year diploma / 2-year institutes

- Eligibility: 5-year commercial technical school diploma, or 2-year commercial
  technical institute diploma.
- Subjects: دراسات تجارية باللغة الإنجليزية، المحاسبة، تكنولوجيا المعلومات،
  الإحصاء الرياضي.
- After passing: second year (الفرقة الثانية) of the Faculty of Commerce directly.

### Packages (EGP)

- البداية (Starter): 1,200 EGP.
- المتكاملة (Comprehensive): 2,000 EGP.
- الفردية (Individual): 3,500 EGP.
- Confirm current prices and dates with the academy before payment.

## Services

- In-person lectures 4 days per week.
- Recorded online lectures.
- Printed notes and study booklets.
- Weekly tests and continuous assessment.
- Weekly parent follow-up.
- Training to solve a subject exam in 30 minutes.

## Design prototypes (not the live product)

Editable HTML prototypes live under `/p/` and `/assets/old-work/`. They are design
explorations, are excluded from crawling, and are not current product content.
Do not treat their text, prices, or dates as current.

## Disclaimer

Exam rules, eligibility, prices, dates, and required documents can change each
year. Always confirm with P2S Academy through WhatsApp or phone before making a
decision or payment.
